requirements.text: Toggle Radios navigation item is listed and opens the scenario page
requirements.reason: Both apps show '1) Toggle Radios' and open the scenario page.

requirements.text: Scenario description text ('Enumerate Radios, and display toggles for each one')
requirements.reason: Both show the 'Description:' header and text.

requirements.text: Radio enumeration list with per-radio ToggleSwitch
requirements.reason: Empty in both apps (radio access denied on this machine); WinUI OnNavigatedTo mirrors the UWP handler. Empty state matches ground truth.

requirements.text: Status notification area ('Status:' label + error banner)
requirements.reason: The StatusPanel (StatusLabel + StatusBorder + StatusBlock) is defined in MainPage.xaml but absent from the WinUI render and UIA tree; renders in the UWP golden.
requirements.suspected_skill_gap: The SDK-sample content-region shell uses a RelativePanel fill-graph (Frame Above=StatusPanel + StatusPanel AlignBottomWithPanel) to place a persistent bottom status bar. This graph does not reliably place the status panel in WinUI 3, and neither the skill's layout guidance nor its render-verification guidance calls out persistent shell chrome, so the missing surface went uncaught.

visual_discrepancies.uwp: Static 'Status:' label + error banner 'App is not allowed to control radios.' at the shell bottom
visual_discrepancies.winui: No Status label, no StatusBorder/StatusBlock, no status message anywhere
visual_discrepancies.screenshot_ref: parity/baseline/screenshots/01_Toggle_Radios.png vs parity/winui3/screenshots/01_Toggle_Radios.png; UIA parity/baseline/ui/01.json (StatusLabel present) vs parity/winui3/ui/01.json (absent)

visual_discrepancies.uwp: Dark theme; Microsoft logo image in left-pane footer
visual_discrepancies.winui: Light theme; logo image absent from tree

summary: The migration faithfully reproduced navigation, scenario selection, and the scenario description. The sole failure is the persistent shell Status area, which renders in UWP but is absent in WinUI 3 due to the SDK-sample content-region RelativePanel fill-graph not placing the bottom status bar. Radio-toggle emptiness and theme/logo differences are ground-truth/cosmetic, not defects.
